accurate.en: Accurate measurements are essential when comparing the two experiments.
accurate.zh: 比較兩個實驗時，精確的測量非常重要。

acquire.en: Students acquire new vocabulary through regular reading and practice.
acquire.zh: 學生透過規律閱讀與練習習得新字彙。

adequate.en: The classroom has adequate lighting for reading and group work.
adequate.zh: 這間教室有足夠的照明供閱讀與小組活動使用。

adjust.en: You may need to adjust the plan after receiving feedback.
adjust.zh: 收到回饋後，你可能需要調整計畫。

allocate.en: The team will allocate more time to the most difficult task.
allocate.zh: 團隊會分配更多時間給最困難的任務。

analyze.en: Students analyze the data before writing their final conclusion.
analyze.zh: 學生在撰寫最後結論前先分析資料。

apparent.en: It became apparent that the second method was more efficient.
apparent.zh: 很明顯第二種方法更有效率。

approximate.en: The map shows the approximate location of the old railway station.
approximate.zh: 地圖顯示舊火車站的大約位置。

attribute.en: Researchers attribute the improvement to better study habits.
attribute.zh: 研究人員將這項進步歸因於更好的讀書習慣。

bias.en: A good survey should reduce bias in its questions.
bias.zh: 好的問卷應降低題目中的偏誤。

brief.en: The teacher gave a brief explanation before the activity began.
brief.zh: 活動開始前，老師做了簡短說明。

cease.en: The rain began to cease shortly before the outdoor event.
cease.zh: 戶外活動開始前不久，雨勢開始停止。

clarify.en: Please clarify your main point with one concrete example.
clarify.zh: 請用一個具體例子說明你的主要觀點。

coherent.en: A coherent essay connects each paragraph to the main argument.
coherent.zh: 連貫的文章會把每一段都連結到主要論點。

compile.en: Students compile information from several reliable sources for the report.
compile.zh: 學生從數個可靠來源整理資訊來完成報告。

complex.en: The diagram makes a complex process easier to understand.
complex.zh: 這張圖讓複雜的過程更容易理解。

component.en: Each component of the machine has a different function.
component.zh: 機器的每個組件都有不同功能。

conduct.en: The class will conduct a small survey about reading habits.
conduct.zh: 全班將進行一項關於閱讀習慣的小型調查。

confirm.en: Further testing will confirm whether the first result was reliable.
confirm.zh: 進一步測試將確認第一次的結果是否可靠。

considerable.en: The new system saved a considerable amount of time.
considerable.zh: 新系統節省了相當多的時間。

consistent.en: The results were consistent across all three groups.
consistent.zh: 三個小組的結果都一致。

constraint.en: Limited time was the main constraint on the project.
constraint.zh: 時間有限是這項專題的主要限制。

context.en: The meaning of a word often depends on its context.
context.zh: 單字的意思常取決於它所在的上下文。

contrast.en: The report draws a clear contrast between the two approaches.
contrast.zh: 這份報告清楚對比了兩種方法。

convert.en: The program can convert the data into a simple chart.
convert.zh: 這個程式可以把資料轉換成簡單圖表。

coordinate.en: Teachers coordinate the schedule so major tests do not overlap.
coordinate.zh: 老師會協調時程，避免重要考試重疊。

core.en: The core idea of the lesson is easy to remember.
core.zh: 這堂課的核心概念很容易記住。

correspond.en: The numbers in the table correspond to locations on the map.
correspond.zh: 表格中的數字對應到地圖上的位置。

crucial.en: Clear evidence is crucial when making a scientific claim.
crucial.zh: 提出科學主張時，清楚的證據非常重要。

decline.en: The graph shows a gradual decline in energy use.
decline.zh: 圖表顯示能源使用量逐漸下降。

demonstrate.en: The experiment will demonstrate how pressure affects the container.
demonstrate.zh: 這項實驗將展示壓力如何影響容器。

deviate.en: Results may deviate slightly when the room temperature changes.
deviate.zh: 室溫改變時，結果可能會有些微偏差。

distinguish.en: Students learn to distinguish reliable sources from unreliable ones.
distinguish.zh: 學生學習分辨可靠與不可靠的資料來源。

diverse.en: The club includes students from diverse backgrounds and interests.
diverse.zh: 這個社團包含來自不同背景與興趣的學生。

eliminate.en: The team tried to eliminate unnecessary steps from the process.
eliminate.zh: 團隊試著刪除流程中不必要的步驟。

emerge.en: A clear pattern began to emerge after more data were collected.
emerge.zh: 蒐集更多資料後，一個明顯的模式開始出現。

empirical.en: The conclusion is supported by empirical evidence from repeated experiments.
empirical.zh: 這項結論有重複實驗所得的實證證據支持。

enhance.en: Better lighting can enhance concentration in the study area.
enhance.zh: 更好的照明可以提升讀書區的專注力。

ensure.en: Double-check the instructions to ensure every step is completed.
ensure.zh: 再次確認說明，以確保每個步驟都完成。

estimate.en: We can estimate the distance by using the map scale.
estimate.zh: 我們可以利用地圖比例尺估算距離。

exclude.en: The study will exclude incomplete responses from the final analysis.
exclude.zh: 這項研究會把不完整的回答排除在最後分析之外。

explicit.en: The instructions give explicit rules for formatting the report.
explicit.zh: 說明中明確列出報告格式的規則。

facilitate.en: Shared documents can facilitate cooperation during group projects.
facilitate.zh: 共享文件可以促進小組專題中的合作。

feasible.en: The team chose a feasible plan that fit the available time.
feasible.zh: 團隊選擇了一個符合現有時間的可行計畫。

fluctuate.en: Electricity use can fluctuate during different parts of the day.
fluctuate.zh: 用電量可能在一天不同時段波動。

focus.en: Please focus on the main question when writing your answer.
focus.zh: 寫答案時請聚焦在主要問題上。

generate.en: Solar panels generate electricity from sunlight during the day.
generate.zh: 太陽能板在白天利用陽光發電。

illustration.en: The textbook includes an illustration of the human heart.
illustration.zh: 課本中有一張人體心臟的插圖。

incentive.en: The school offered an incentive for classes that reduced waste.
incentive.zh: 學校為減少垃圾的班級提供獎勵。

incorporate.en: The revised report will incorporate feedback from both teachers.
incorporate.zh: 修訂後的報告會納入兩位老師的回饋。

infer.en: Readers can infer the character's feelings from her actions.
infer.zh: 讀者可以從角色的行動推測她的感受。

integrate.en: The project will integrate science, technology, and design skills.
integrate.zh: 這項專題將整合科學、科技與設計能力。

justify.en: Students should justify each answer with evidence from the passage.
justify.zh: 學生應用文章中的證據說明每個答案的理由。

modify.en: The group decided to modify the design after the first test.
modify.zh: 第一次測試後，小組決定修改設計。

objective.en: Our objective is to reduce unnecessary energy use at school.
objective.zh: 我們的目標是減少校園中不必要的能源使用。

parameter.en: Temperature is an important parameter in this experiment.
parameter.zh: 溫度是這項實驗中的重要參數。

persist.en: The problem may persist unless the damaged part is replaced.
persist.zh: 除非更換損壞零件，這個問題可能會持續存在。

principal.en: The principal reason for the delay was heavy rain.
principal.zh: 延誤的主要原因是大雨。

reinforce.en: Regular review can reinforce what students learned in class.
reinforce.zh: 規律複習可以強化學生在課堂上學到的內容。

retain.en: Students retain information better when they review it regularly.
retain.zh: 學生規律複習時能更好地保留資訊。

revise.en: Please revise the paragraph after reading the teacher's comments.
revise.zh: 閱讀老師的評語後，請修改這一段。

signify.en: A flashing light may signify that the machine needs attention.
signify.zh: 閃爍的燈可能表示機器需要注意。

substantial.en: The project required a substantial amount of planning and teamwork.
substantial.zh: 這項專題需要大量的規劃與團隊合作。

tentative.en: The team made a tentative schedule before confirming all dates.
tentative.zh: 團隊在確認所有日期前先擬定暫定時程。

utilize.en: Students can utilize online databases to find reliable research sources.
utilize.zh: 學生可以利用線上資料庫尋找可靠的研究來源。
